Class PokemonAPI

java.lang.Object
PokemonAPI
public class PokemonAPI extends Object
Provides a static Java API for querying the SQLite Pokemon database (pokemon.db). Manages database connections and exposes methods to retrieve Pokemon records by ID, name, elemental type, generation, legendary status, and base stat totals.

    • getPokemonByType

      public static List<Pokemon> getPokemonByType(String type)
      Retrieves all Pokemon that have the specified elemental type as either their primary type (type1) or secondary type (type2), case-insensitively.
      Parameters:

      Retrieves all Pokemon introduced in a specific generation.
      Parameters:

    • getPokemonWithMinTotalStats

      public static List<Pokemon> getPokemonWithMinTotalStats(int minTotal)
      Retrieves all Pokemon whose Base Stat Total is greater than or equal to the specified minimum. Results are ordered from highest Base Stat Total to lowest.
      Parameters:
      minTotal - the minimum Base Stat Total threshold (e.g., 600)
      Returns:
      a List of Pokemon objects meeting or exceeding minTotal
